normalization_policy_version: matching-v1: Unicode casefold; trim and collapse whitespace; punctuation retained
grouping_policy_version: leakage-groups-v1: exact/normalized text, near-text candidates, enterprise product groups, and every same-normalized-name candidate set connect groups; same-name identity/conflict links require a shared non-generic vendor; domains are ambiguous evidence only
near_duplicate_policy_version: near-text-v1: token Jaccard >= 0.82; >= 8 distinct tokens, >= 60 chars, and >= 6 shared tokens; rare-token inverted index capped at 100 postings per token
